chapter.title: A Banner Without a Master
chapter.subtitle: A festival sells Yasuke’s face before asking. Its sponsor wants the children out once the cameras leave.
chapter.description: A festival sells Yasuke’s face before asking. Its sponsor wants the children out once the cameras leave.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Why is my face advertising VIP sword lessons?

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: Preliminary enthusiasm. The printer got ahead of us.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: The printer also wrote “touch the blade, touch greatness”?

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: For forty dollars, I expected at least a small cut.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: Tournament money repairs the youth courtyard. Sponsor wants private-club rights after the opening.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: So the children pay with their faces and leave when the cameras do.

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: When you phrase it like that—

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: How did you phrase it?

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: Legacy access.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Bring the contract.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: The marshals received four contradictory signal cards. Somebody translated “clear the floor” as “clear the neighborhood.”

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: I sent everybody home. Very efficient, very lonely.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Use the constraints. Let the young marshal call the sequence. She has actually read them.

puzzle.title: The marshal’s disputed signals
puzzle.instruction: Arrange the four banners into a valid opening. Red cannot precede gold. Blue immediately follows white. Gold is neither first nor second. These constraints are from the signed marshal sheet, not the sponsor’s flyer.

pieces.label: Gold stripe
pieces.detail: Admit spectators to the marked seats.

hints: Blue and white form a pair. Gold needs a later slot, with red still after it.
Gold must be third, leaving white and blue first and second.
puzzle.solvedText: The young marshal opens the court correctly. The sponsor’s “VIP entry first” flyer goes in the bin.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
preDialogue.text: Sponsor’s qualifier closes the middle in round three. Hold the outer districts. Charging the biggest target is how you leave a door unguarded.

preDialogue.speaker: Promoter
preDialogue.text: Can you say that while pointing at the logo?

preDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
preDialogue.text: I can point at the exit.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: Crowd got louder for the save than the big hit.

postDialogue.speaker: Promoter
postDialogue.text: Sponsor asked whether we could save with more brand visibility.

passive.name: A Shield for the Smallest
passive.description: The center district closes to new plays in round three.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: The posted contract and the sponsor’s copy disagree. Track the edits. Someone removed the free hours after the youth organizer signed.

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: That may be a version-control issue.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Then we will control the version.

puzzle.title: Catch the switched copy
puzzle.instruction: Order five versions of the agreement by their physical evidence. New marks remain on later copies unless a note explicitly says a clause was removed. Find when free public hours disappeared.

pieces.label: Youth copy
pieces.detail: Adds free hours; no signature or stamp.

pieces.label: Sponsor copy
pieces.detail: Same signature, sponsor stamp; free-hours paragraph removed.

pieces.label: Filed correction
pieces.detail: Both marks retained. Free hours restored and margin initialed by both parties.

pieces.label: Signed copy
pieces.detail: Free hours plus the organizer’s signature. No sponsor stamp.

pieces.label: Draft A
pieces.detail: Plain text. No signatures, stamp, or free-hours clause.

hints: Track additions first. A later deletion does not make a copy an earlier draft.
The sponsor stamp first appears on the version that removes free hours.
puzzle.solvedText: The sponsor removed public access after the organizer signed. The filed correction restores it with both initials; the original alteration remains visible in the record.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

preDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
preDialogue.text: The restored agreement is filed. Now his champion wants the final match and the naming rights on the trophy.

preDialogue.speaker: Cornball
preDialogue.text: Call it the Read Before You Sign Invitational.

preDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
preDialogue.text: Six rounds. He gains a Motion in round four. Watch his reserve, not his entrance.

postDialogue.speaker: Promoter
postDialogue.text: Champion lost. Sponsor wants the trophy cropped out of the recap.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball
postDialogue.text: I’m filming horizontal out of spite.

starObjectives.description: Win all three districts against the final crew.

passive.description: At round four, The Opps gain 1 Motion.

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: Your portrait over the gate?

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Opening hours.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: My portrait by the snack stand?

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Prices.

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: You’re difficult to merchandise.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: You are finding out slowly.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: Young marshal gets the ribbon. She wants to know if you can cut it with the sword.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Scissors.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: But the footage—

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Scissors.

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: She brought her own. Doesn’t trust any of us.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Keep the courtyard open. Keep the names of the people who fixed it on the wall.

scenes.speaker: Promoter
scenes.text: And no VIP sword lessons.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Now you have understood.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: What about regular sword questions?

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: You have reached your limit.
